nycosm: OpenStreetMap Features for New York City

Source: R/nycosm-package.R
nycosm-package.Rd

OpenStreetMap features for New York City: points of interest, streets, paths, rail, buildings, land use, parks, water, and transit routes, clipped to the five boroughs, with full key-value tags. Data are stored as GeoParquet files and accessed via duckplyr. Map data copyright OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0 https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright.
